main_theorem.hypotheses: Original-coordinate H, |H|=m>=3; A final; C=A[H,H], B=A[H,Hc]; lambda3(C^2+BB^T)>=g^2; C=lambda uu^T+E, |lambda|=c=s1(C), ||E||=b=s2(C), c>mb; choose |u_i|>=m^-1/2; alpha=c/m-b; h=||B_i||.
main_theorem.conclusion: For B#=B[K,*]-(C[K,i]/C_ii)B_i, s2(B#)>=Delta_R1:=g-b-((1+sqrt(m-1))b/alpha)h. If Delta_R1>0 then ||p||_(infinity,ess)<=2^(11/4) binom(m-1,2)^(1/8)/sqrt(alpha Delta_R1).
main_theorem.exact_endpoint: If b=0 then s2(B#)>=g, independently of h; exact rank-one-self endpoint of partner rank-two tube is paid.
main_theorem.failure_certificate: If b>0 and new exit fails, h>=alpha(g-b)/((1+sqrt(m-1))b), hence h grows at least like 1/b as b->0.
